server_hostname.description: Hostname or FQDN of the AREX service (e.g., arc.example.com)

server_port.description: TCP port on which the AREX service listens (commonly 443 for HTTPS)

rest_enabled.description: Enable or disable the REST API endpoint (required for ARC 6+ clients)

websocket_enabled.description: Enable or disable the WebSocket endpoint for live job updates

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs this service instance will manage (prevents resource exhaustion)

job_state_path.description: Path to the directory storing job state information (must be writable by arc user)

job_output_path.description: Path to the directory where job outputs are staged for retrieval

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle incoming REST/WebSocket requests

gridftp_enabled.description: Enable or disable GridFTP data transfer support

gridftp_ports.description: List of ports for GridFTP data connections (first is control port; range for data ports)

items.description: TCP port number (e.g., 2811 for control, or range 50000-51000 for data)

job_managers.description: List of job managers to handle jobs for specific computing resources

name.description: Unique identifier for this job manager (used in service URLs)

resource.description: Hostname or identifier of the computing resource (e.g., batch scheduler host)

queue.description: Batch queue or partition to use (leave empty to use default)

workdir.description: Optional working directory for this job manager (must be accessible to arc user)

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency)
